fightLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 2). Honey is antibacterial. Sugar packs wounds. Yarrow stops bleeding. The old ways work.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Monique Berger. Dentist. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Seed packet, Field suture kit, Reading Glasses, Father's Whetstone, Mother's Ring. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
🎒 A woman, maybe 30s shoulders a pack. "Going far this time. Don't wait up."
You remember the Fire-hardened spear at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Running Shoes at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
📺 A woman, maybe 30s killed a dog-shaped silence at the treeline out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 3 rounds, 58 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)

You catch A person, maybe 60s, with a farmer's tan telling the fire about A woman, maybe 30s. "A woman, maybe 30s killed a dog-shaped silence at the treeline out past the ridge" The story's already growing.
🎒 A person, maybe 20s shoulders a pack. "Going far this time. Don't wait up."

🔥 The fire settles. the woman in her 30s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the person in their 20s asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Jorge breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
🍽️ Owen eyes the groaning pantry shelves and packs light today. "No point hauling what'll rot. Mending the nets instead."
